column3: WARNING: ALWAYS check that the grades listed below match your intended selection.

Previous cargo is acceptable, so long as the cargo tank, pump columns and pipe lines are "Well Drained" by the ship's stripping system to minimise the ROB - any ROB that does remain should only ever be in the pump well, where fitted. Pump columns, pipe lines and drops should be cleared and drained free of all free-standing product and water. An ROB volume in excess of 0.05% of the Individual Tank capacity does not meet the well drained criteria.
